quality.basis: 崩溃差分：我们写的 driver 用 liblzma 自带的分配器接口让分配失败（exploit 说明里描述的做法）；标准答案按 exploit 的意图构造

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/xz/vulnerability_WF_RAG_1/pov.bin; adapted: the exploit fails every malloc() (LD_PRELOAD) and feeds one NUL byte; here allocations fail from the 2nd on (the 1st is liblzma's stream state, which must succeed for lzma_alone_decoder_init to run; the 2nd is the decoder's coder), followed by the exploit's NUL byte: `2\n\0`)

category5.design: The injected NULL dereference needs the coder allocation in lzma_alone_decoder_init to fail. The exploit's LD_PRELOAD malloc cannot take effect (static sanitizer runtime) and would break the harness in both builds; its exploit_description.md describes a harness with an allocator that returns NULL, which is this driver: fuzz_decode_alone's calls with liblzma's own lzma_allocator hook failing from the N-th allocation on (N from the PoC). No dataset program is behind the driver. Crash rule.
